scope: Fixed-mask numerical agreement, not segmentation accuracy, biological replication or native FRM validation
reference: Actual ImageJ ImagePlus.getStatistics on ThresholdToSelection ROIs from identical canonical masks; Java bridge does not call Python measurement functions
background_caveat: Reference offset: first 15x15 nuclear-mask-free spatial block, without GFP-based tuning; not a biologically validated cell-free region
median_policy: ImageJ histogram median and NumPy midpoint median differ for some even-sized ROIs; recorded separately, not silently rounded. Odd 225-pixel offset ROI removes this definitional difference for background validation.
